content:
Alex K: heads-up — found possible creds in yesterday's analytics export to partner S3. looks like a base64 blob in column user_meta. suspect it's an old Vault token (staging-svc-legacy).
Maria V: omg. can you paste sample (no creds) and path? :eyes:
Alex K: sample: 'dG9rZW46c3RhZ2luZ19zdmM6MTIzNDU=' — decoded shows 'token:staging_svc:12345' — file s3://redwood-analytics/exports/partner_a/2026-03-20/metrics.csv
Jen SRE: oncall-bot, we've got a potential secret in public partner export. kick off containment checklist?
Oncall Bot: Incident created: SEC-2026-031. Pager duty notified. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/secret-exposure
Tim Sec: steps: 1) revoke token 2) rotate any KMS keys used to wrap backups referencing that token 3) audit logs 4) notify partner
Raj: who owns staging-svc-legacy? I can run a rotate if we confirm it's still used.
Alex K: owner in IAM shows 'staging-team'. reaching out to @staging-team. For now, please revoke if possible. I'll pull precise object key list.
Maria V: quick grep I ran: aws s3api list-objects --bucket redwood-analytics --prefix exports/partner_a/2026-03-20 | jq -r '.Contents[].Key' | xargs -n1 aws s3 cp s3://redwood-analytics/{} - | grep -n 'dG9rZW46'
Jen SRE: Good, also enable Vault audit logging for staging namespace (if not already). Tim, add policy change to block legacy token usage and rotate to short-lived tokens.
Tim Sec: Will open RBAC change: staging-team svc account gets 'no long-lived tokens' flag. Also schedule rewrap of any snapshots encrypted with old KMS key alias 'alias/old-staging-backup'.
Alex K: Partner notified via secure channel: we've requested they pause ingestion from that path. Waiting for acknowledgment.
Raj: I revoked the token (vault token revoke <token>) and disabled the IAM service account key used by the service. Confirmed 200. Audit id: audit-4789.
Tim Sec: Nice. Next: run a grep across all partner export prefixes for base64 patterns — I've shared a short script in #eng-security-gists. Also we'll do a KMS key rewrap: `kms re-encrypt --source-kms-key alias/old-staging-backup --destination-kms-key alias/staging-2026-03`
Maria V: After RC, we should run an attrs diff to ensure no other exports include PII or tokens. Also add an automated check to the export pipeline to scrub base64-looking blobs.
Oncall Bot: Incident SEC-2026-031 status: containment in progress. Assigned: Raj, Tim Sec, Alex K, Maria V, Jen SRE.
Alex K: Timeline: initial discovery 2026-03-20 22:14 UTC. revoke done 22:25. partner ingestion paused 22:40. next steps: rotate KMS by EOD and confirm audit entries.
Jen SRE: I'll run postmortem template after close. Quick note: add 'strip_user_meta' transform to analytics pipeline config. PR incoming.
Tim Sec: Also run a Vault token lease audit: `vault token lookup` and force revoke any matching client_ids.
Raj: closing loop — partner ack'd pause and will purge objects. I'll keep thread updated. :thumbsup:
